summary.text: Elizabeth Rowray is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 35, has served since 2020, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Elizabeth Rowray lives in Yorktown, Indiana, graduated from Muncie Burris High School, and earned a B.S. from Ball State University.
Her career experience includes working as legislative director for former U.S. Congressman Mark Souder and as a nonprofit consultant.
Rowray assumed office on November 4, 2020, succeeding Melanie Wright, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the November 3, 2026 general election she faces Democrat Philip Gift.
For 2025-2026, she was assigned to the Commerce, Small Business and Economic Development, Family, Children and Human Affairs, and Ways and Means committees.
